title: kith-attach: blob_path debug_assert elided in release — callers can pass unsanitized ids
description: blob_path() uses debug_assert\!(validate_blob_id(id).is_ok(), ...) which is compiled out in release builds (cargo build --release). The comment says 'callers must validate first' but there is no release-mode enforcement. A caller that forgets to validate and passes an attacker-supplied id would path-join it directly onto base_dir, enabling traversal in release builds. Should be an explicit Err return or at minimum a non-debug assert.
